trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Oil Supply Risk
trends.summary: Iran fortifying Kharg Island (90% of crude exports) with mines and air defenses; US troops relocating due to severe damage from Iranian attacks; Russia evacuating staff from Bushehr nuclear plant. Oil prices rising sharply as geopolitical risk premium expands. Critical supply-side shock to energy markets with potential for further escalation.

trends.name: Fed Policy Easing & Neutral Rate Debate
trends.summary: Fed's Miran signals lower neutral rate than colleagues, indicates Fed is 1ppt over neutral and should cut toward neutral this year. Policy currently 'wrongly holding economy back.' Headline inflation projection raised to 2.7% on oil shock, but market inflation expectations remain unmoved. Critical signal for rate cut trajectory in 2026.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Inflation Risk
trends.summary: Oil prices rising sharply due to Iran tensions and potential supply disruptions. USPS seeking 8% fuel surcharge; headline inflation raised to 2.7% by Fed officials. Fed emphasizes 'zero bleed through' into wage expectations so far, but sustained oil shock could reignite inflation fears and complicate easing cycle.

trends.name: White House Shutdown & TSA Funding Crisis
trends.summary: Government shutdown creating operational chaos with long TSA lines; White House rejected Elon Musk's offer to cover TSA worker salaries. Political gridlock between Republicans and Democrats on DHS shutdown counteroffer. Growing political dysfunction risks wider fiscal impacts and market uncertainty.

trends.name: Tech Sector Weakness & Nasdaq Correction
trends.summary: Nasdaq (QQQ) has been down for 100 days since peak, signaling sustained tech sector weakness. Micron stock dropping amid Google dependency concerns. Arm rebounding with best day in a year on AI narrative revival, but broader tech momentum under pressure.

trends.name: Trump Political Risk & Impeachment Odds Rising
trends.summary: Prediction markets showing Trump impeachment probability at 73%, up steadily in recent months. Trump criticized Supreme Court Justices Barrett and Gorsuch on tariff ruling; Republicans blocking Democratic subpoena push for Trump Jr. Elevated political uncertainty affecting market stability and policy predictability.

trends.name: Private Equity M&A Activity & Exit Bets
trends.summary: KKR's $4.75B sale of data-center cooling business CoolIT to Ecolab positioned as one of PE's most successful bets. Activist hedge fund building 2.5% stake in Driven Brands pushing for sale or breakup. PE firms accelerating exits and consolidation plays amid market uncertainty.

trends.name: Bank Sector Stagflation Fears & Rate Volatility
trends.summary: Bank investors experiencing stress over stagflation whiff — combination of inflation risk (oil shock) and easing cycle. Fed policy uncertainty creating volatility in rate expectations. Banking sector valuations pressured by competing inflation/recession dynamics and mortgage rate elevation near 6-month highs.

trends.name: Lithium & Commodity Cyclicals Reset
trends.summary: Lithium miner news and commodity cycles being reset by geopolitical disruptions and inflation concerns. Bunge Global upgraded on Middle East conflict as catalyst, but long-term execution remains key story. Commodities repricing on both supply (Iran) and demand (growth) uncertainty.

trends.name: Consumer Discretionary & Restaurant Demand Resilience
trends.summary: Darden Restaurants reiterating buy rating as consumer demand outlook remains solid despite macro headwinds. McDonald's 'KPop Demon Hunters' meal generating $100M potential revenue in first days, signaling brand-driven traffic. Consumer spending holding up but facing geopolitical/inflation headwinds.

trends.name: Nestlé Transformation Execution Risk & Downgrades
trends.summary: Nestlé downgraded despite transformation momentum, with execution risk rising as a key concern. Signals that major consumer staple transformations facing skepticism from analysts. Corporate restructuring narratives under pressure from implementation challenges and market volatility.

trends.name: Meta Antitrust & Child Safety Liability Exposure
trends.summary: New Mexico AG won major lawsuit against Meta on child safety grounds; jury sent strong message to entire social media industry. Landmark decision signals increasing liability exposure for tech giants on content moderation and youth protection. Sets precedent for state-level regulatory pressure on Big Tech.
